(1) NAS detection is a new task to detect samples from the distribution shifted by natural attributes and that (2) distance-based OOD detection is sensitive to the location of NAS in the feature space, while confidence-based OOD is not.

(i) the performance of prior OOD detection methods on NAS samples is highly inconsistent and (ii) a simple modification to training objective of OOD detection methods can improve their performance on NAS detection task.
